label: TP-Link EAP235-Wall
description: AC1200 wall-plate access point with a four-port faceplate: one gigabit uplink (PoE in) and three gigabit downlinks, one of them with PoE passthrough.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: uplink 1x gigabit Ethernet port, downlink 3x gigabit Ethernet ports of which one supports PoE passthrough; 802.3af/at PoE input. The radios are modelled as AC1200 (300M + 867M) from the product's stated class; the per-band rate row was not captured on this page, so the figure follows the family rather than a quoted row - worth a comment if the exact rates matter.
